desc: Vitae Perception - 10 second Y/N discern used on the corpse or, in the case of magical creatures which leave no bodies the place where they died. costs 1 tblp casting damage. This damage can be taken against casting stamina. If the target has vitae remaining the answer is Yes. If the target has no vitae remaining or never had any the answer is No.
2nd Resistance to Touch of Death and Suspend Life. Touch of Death now goes to Cause Grievous, and Suspend Life to Cause Serious.
Survival of a Mercenary - From Enhanced Rebirth upon rebirthing may now choose to retain 10% of their points.
From Active (including 10 innate neuronic penetrations) and Passive Neuronic Trees gains Utilise Neuronic Items.

Immunity to all Dying Effects. Must have Immunity to Bless/Curse and Resistance to Avenging Spirit. This means that upon taking a dying effect and becoming aware of what it is they may, instead of taking the dying effect, choose to be unconscious for 5 minutes. It should be noted the choice must be made at the point of taking the dying effect, not after working out how much damage it might do.
Traitors Shield, 6pt non cumulative damage reduction to first three blows to the back in each combat, only works if the character was genuinely unaware of the existence of the assailant.
Determination, instead of suffering a listed stopping effect, character takes 6 tblp, even if immune to the stopping effect
Enhanced Determination. When using Determination, should a character receive the same listed stopping affect simultaneously then only one use of determination is required.
Fully utilise spiritual side of mantic items of own alignment /colour
Utilise solely spiritual items of own alignment [from spiritual side of mantic items].
